reserveReview.rationale: The live USD.AI reserve index observed on 2026-10-29 identifies 59.85662601% PYUSD and 40.14337399% across 21 share-bearing GPU loans. Published shares total 100%; six entries without share weights are not assigned additional exposure. At Arbitrum block 519430000 (2026-10-29T17:55:30Z), PYUSD balanceOf(USDai) returned 269640938241417 base units (269,640,938.241417 PYUSD), 59.617 PYUSD above the 269,640,878.624731 the same-run API normalizes, a difference consistent with the API snapshot lag. The GPU slice now carries a stated hard maturity maximum of 1,095 days: every share-bearing loan discloses a contractual term at or below 94,608,000 seconds, and the 1,460- and 1,825-day entries carry no share weight. This review verifies the current issuer-disclosed composition, liquid balance and disclosed loan terms, not the off-chain GPU identity, appraisal, insurance, SPV structure, or loan enforceability. Loan values and terms remain issuer-disclosed. Existing source keys and the serial-wrapper dependency treatment are retained.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: sUSDai is a serial wrapper of USDai; this PYUSD slice is the look-through of the parent's backing. The PYUSD exposure is inherited through the reviewed serial wrapper edge to usdai-usd-ai (whose verified reserve envelope is 100% PYUSD) and is tracked on the parent asset, so the slice is not a separate parallel dependency link.

GPU infrastructure loans are private-credit positions, not tracked stablecoin dependencies. The 2026-10-29 issuer reserve API publishes documentId, borrower, term in seconds, remaining amounts and share per loan: the maximum term among the 21 share-bearing active loans is 94,608,000 seconds (1,095 days), and the 1,460- and 1,825-day entries carry no share weight. That disclosed maximum is the whole-slice maturity bound recorded on the slice; it does not establish borrower credit quality, appraisal, insurance, or enforceability.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Targeted source follow-up on 2026-10-01 identifies Wilmington Trust as segregated per-loan escrow agent where escrow is used, and GPU Finance Ltd. or the appointed GPU Servicer LLC as legal lender/agent. The borrower SPV is described as bankruptcy-remote from its operating-company parent; that is not a whole-vault bankruptcy-remoteness opinion for sUSDai holders or the lender-of-record layer. Binding Terms deny holders a direct contractual claim against an individual borrower. Provider allocations, executed series-specific protection documents, and whole-book reuse/pledge covenants remain undisclosed. The July whole-book review date and unknown-exposure bound are retained, not refreshed from this partial provider identification.
